subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: On the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: an hour without supervision

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four chasme and two vrock

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: key possession
fact: The key once hung around Kalan Strongbranch's neck and was later handed to Daz.
source_quote: It had hung around Kalan Strongbranch's neck once. I... handed it to Daz

subject: sapphire summoning token
fact: The stolen sapphire is a retrieval token for a summoning spell that binds to an item not in any living person's possession.
source_quote: The sapphire isn't decoration: it's the retrieval token... a dead person possesses nothing

subject: poison activation
fact: The poison turns black only upon contact with a living being's saliva, not when exposed to air or inert objects.
source_quote: When I mixed with his saliva, it turned black... The stuff only wakes up when a living thing touches it

subject: Oak Tree Apothecary
fact: The Oak Tree Apothecary is located between the Sea Warden's Tower and the House of Mechanus, a treehouse grown into the roots of an evergreen oak.
source_quote: The Oak Tree Apothecary, he said, between the Sea Warden's Tower and the House of Mechanus, a treehouse grown into the roots of an evergreen oak

subject: key retrieval magic
fact: The summoning spell requires the sapphire to be the same token used for both storage and recall — a backup against key theft.
source_quote: The sapphire is actually used to sort of be able to retrieve the key... a backup, in other words, against theft of the original

subject: poison vial
fact: The poison, in its inactive state, appears as a clear liquid in a vial, not as a dark substance.
source_quote: A vial of some sort of clear

subject: book tampering timeline
fact: The book was placed under the evergreen tree at 11am on Deadwinter's Eve, wrapped, and later picked up by Janussi at dinner — unchanged in appearance.
source_quote: He'd dropped the book under the evergreen tree... around 11am on Deadwinter's Eve... wrapped

subject: dining room
fact: The dining room is one of the rooms left unwatched during the investigation, where a poisoner would logically operate.
source_quote: The dining room, for one. Where the meals were served, and where, if you were a poisoner, you'd have wanted to be.

subject: Fembris departure
fact: Fembris left his post as minder to attend Grygum's theological debate, creating an hour of unsupervised access to the library.
source_quote: Fembris asked to leave... to attend a debate... his departure handed us an hour without supervision

subject: locket contents
fact: The locket taken from the murdered man likely contained the key, which was separate from the sapphire.
source_quote: Some locket from around the dude's neck was taken. We assume that inside that locket was the key.

subject: Zalthir's key inspection
fact: Zalthir's inspection of the key revealed no magical binding to the summoning spell — the key was clean and unrelated to the sapphire's magic.
source_quote: The answer was no. The key was clean. Not linked to that spell, not created by it, carrying no quiet enchantment

subject: Daral's confession
fact: Daral admitted to drunken barroom talk about dragonborn, fearing it might be used to frame him, and believed Zalthir recorded everything.
source_quote: he'd worked out someone wanted him to take the fall... nobody would mention to Zalthir what he'd said about dragonborn. Drunk, barroom talk... Zalthir said, in a voice that recorded everything

subject: Strongbranch's caution
fact: Strongbranch handed over his key because he feared its magical connection to the summoning spell, and understood that a dead man cannot possess anything.
source_quote: Strongbranch handed his off rather than wear it. Paranoid, maybe... you don't survive long arguing with a dead man's caution

subject: Oval Theater
fact: The Oval Theater is where Grygum's theological debate is held, attended by half the Avowed and Bookwyrm herself.
source_quote: a disputation in the Oval Theater on his new theology, with half the avowed already in attendance and Bookwyrm herself unable to politically afford to miss it

subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: The Deadwinter supper began at the 5PM bell.

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four chasme and two vrock

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: An hour later

subject: Candlekeep entrance
fact: Candlekeep's entrance still smells of paper, lamp oil, and old stone warmed by sun unseen for months.
source_quote: The air in Candlekeep still smelled wrong to me. Not bad — paper, lamp oil, old stone warmed by sun I had not seen in months — just wrong

subject: Milil chalice
fact: The lead-lined brass chalice from Milil's statue contains Janussi's heart and a blood-stained meat cleaver.
source_quote: A heart. And a blood-stained meat cleaver.

subject: poison taster
fact: Sprig tasted all the food served at the Deadwinter supper as the official poison taster.
source_quote: Sprig tasted all the food. 'Is she the poison taster?' I asked, and Irony said yes

subject: Southern Dining Hall
fact: The Southern Dining Hall still smells of cold porridge and tallow, with cleared tables and a statue of Milil holding a brass chalice.
source_quote: The dining hall still smelled like breakfast. Long tables, cleared but not reset, that particular morning-after smell of porridge and tallow gone cold.

subject: wrapping paper
fact: The wrapping paper from Janussi's Secret Santa gift was found in his office, not in the dining hall's wicker basket.
source_quote: The wrapping paper turned up in Janussi's office, not here.

subject: A'lai Aivenmore's ascension plot
fact: A'lai Aivenmore planned to frame Daral and eliminate Janussi to clear the way for his own ascension to the council.
source_quote: A'lai Aivenmore. The one who wanted the keep. The one about to be dismissed. The one who saw Daral's love of poetry, his love of fiction, as a threat to his approach to the universe.

subject: Bag of Holding
fact: The Bag of Holding emitted a shifting grey ooze from which Glabbagool's eye rose to observe the bright object in Daz's hand.
source_quote: Then the bag of holding shifted, and Glabbagool offered. An eye rose out of the grey of him — slow, hopeful, the way he does everything now — and pointed itself at the bright thing in Daz's hand

subject: Glabbagool's attempted nose
fact: Glabbagool attempted to grow a nose to smell the poison, though he had no natural nose and his effort was uncertain.
source_quote: Can Glabbagool try to grow a nose and get a good smell of the poison?

subject: Janussi's poisoning
fact: Janussi was poisoned by a book Daral had given him, and his heart was later removed and placed in the lead-lined Milil chalice to prevent resurrection.
source_quote: Poisoned by a book Daral had given him. ... They stole his heart. They didn't want anybody to be able to bring him back and ask him what happened.

subject: Janussi's office
fact: Janussi's office contained the wrapping paper from his Secret Santa gift, indicating it was moved after the dinner.
source_quote: The wrapping paper turned up in Janussi's office, not here.

subject: Alkrist's project
fact: Alkrist promoted 'Tales of War by the Generals That Waged Them' at the Deadwinter supper, a project dismissed by Teles as implausible.
source_quote: Alkrist was cheerful, pitching a project: *Tales of War by the Generals That Waged Them*, first-hand strategy from warlords and commanders around the world.

subject: Irony's truth compulsion
fact: Irony, a junior avowed, compulsively tells the truth, making her a rare and valuable witness in the investigation.
source_quote: I really hate it when people make that joke. I'm so sorry — this compulsive need to always tell the truth.

subject: Candlekeep conference hall
fact: The Candlekeep conference hall was occupied by the most learned people on the surface, all gathered for a meeting where the murder plot unfolded.
source_quote: The thing about Candlekeep was that it was full of the most learned people on the surface, and every one of them was at the conference.

subject: Daral's mistaken blame
fact: Daral was falsely suspected of being the murderer because he gave Janussi the poisoned book and was emotionally entangled in the case.
source_quote: Maybe they wanted me to be blamed.

subject: meat cleaver
fact: The blood-stained meat cleaver found in the Milil chalice was used to remove Janussi's heart after poisoning.
source_quote: A heart. And a blood-stained meat cleaver.

subject: Secret Santa gift exchange
fact: During the Deadwinter supper, Secret Santa gifts were distributed by Kazryn Nyantani, with Janussi taking his unwrapped and leaving the paper in a basket.
source_quote: Sylvira Savikas stormed out, and Kazryn Nyantani took it on herself to hand out the gifts under the evergreen tree, gave each one to the matching great reader.

fact: The session occurs on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: On the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: One in the morning

source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: elapsed time
fact: The event occurred at dawn.
source_quote: One in the morning

subject: tiefling count
fact: A tiefling is present and does not require light.
source_quote: Sylvira's a tiefling. A tiefling doesn't need the light.

subject: poison taster incident
fact: The poison taster was collateral in a targeted assassination.
source_quote: the taster's just collateral: she'd have gone down at midnight too

subject: Candlekeep poison vial location
fact: A dangerous toxin vial was broken and concealed under the top shelf.
source_quote: Under the top shelf I found a peppermint-soaked rag and a broken vial

subject: Alkrist's scrap of paper
fact: A scrap of paper was fed to a candle and dropped when witnesses arrived.
source_quote: Alkrist had been holding a small scrap of paper toward a candle, feeding it to the flame, and when two junior avowed walked in, he dropped it.

subject: Janussi's Deadwinter gift string
fact: The string tied around Janussi's Deadwinter gift had been cut and retied.
source_quote: the string tied around Janussi's Deadwinter gift had clearly been cut and retied

subject: A'lai's dove cage
fact: A dove cage built for five contained only two birds, indicating three messages were sent.
source_quote: The cage was built for five. Two birds sat in it. There had been more than two.

subject: Alkrist's 1001 Tashalian Nights bookmark
fact: The bookmark was placed on the tale of a commander poisoned by a magic horn coated in Midnight Tears.
source_quote: The bookmark sat on the tale of a military commander, poisoned by a gift of surrender — a magic horn whose mouthpiece had been coated in Midnight Tears.

subject: Alkrist's dead rat jars
fact: Sealed glass jars held dead rats with blistered, pustule-risen skin, indicating poison study.
source_quote: sealed glass jars holding dead rats, their skin blistered and risen into pustules

subject: dragonborn poison theft
fact: A dragonborn broke a vial of dangerous toxin while the druid was distracted in the greenhouse.
source_quote: the dragonborn did the upstairs work and the handling of a substance that might kill whoever carries it

subject: Candlekeep dangerous toxins shelf
fact: A shelf labeled in Elvish as 'Dangerous Toxins' was the site of a concealed breakage.
source_quote: the shelf above the spillage was labeled, in Elvish, *Dangerous Toxins.*

subject: Nibbles the squirrel's nut tokens
fact: A squirrel was bribed with nuts to witness the poison theft and provide testimony.
source_quote: a drow on his knees, bribing a squirrel one nut at a time

subject: Irony's evasion
fact: Irony pointed investigators toward Sprig rather than speak falsely, exploiting the 'can't lie' loophole.
source_quote: She steered us rather than speak false. Worth remembering how she dodges.

subject: A'lai's greenhouse
fact: A magic-enhanced greenhouse below the apothecary was used to distract the druid during the theft.
source_quote: Leuwin took him down through the rear exit to the greenhouse below, where he grows herbs year-round with magic.

subject: Glabbagool the ooze's partnership
fact: An ooze named Glabbagool assisted in searching the Readers' chambers by flowing where the investigator could not reach.
source_quote: He flowed where I could not reach; I read what he could not understand.

subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: Midnight Tears

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: I set the book back exactly as it lay

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: Daz would note it without regret: we are not the famed Whistler, no safecracker of that old generation among us

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: The opening was a finger's width, no more — a true safe, not one of the old massive locks a body could pour itself through

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Her chambers took half the top floor — comfortable, neatly arranged, no extravagance to it

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: Jars of blistered rats. A page marked to a poisoning by gift

subject: cage missing birds
fact: A cage is missing three birds.
source_quote: A cage missing three birds

subject: jar of blistered rats value
fact: The jars of blistered rats are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: Jars of blistered rats

subject: page marked to poisoning by gift
fact: A page is marked to a poisoning by gift.
source_quote: A page marked to a poisoning by gift

subject: safe location
fact: The safe stays shut and is noted by Daz without regret.
source_quote: a locked safe. *Daz would note it without regret: we are not the famed Whistler, no safecracker of that old generation among us. The safe stays shut.*

subject: Glabbagool attempts infiltration
fact: Glabbagool could not thin himself past the finger-width opening.
source_quote: Can Glabbagool just kind of sneak inside, slip inside? No. The opening was a finger's width, no more — a true safe, not one of the old massive locks a body could pour itself through. Glabbagool could not thin himself past it.

subject: clean room
fact: The room is clean and holds no poison.
source_quote: Glabbagool tasted the air and found no poison in it. A clean room. That, too, was information.

subject: we had several leads
fact: We had several leads.
source_quote: We had several. A cage missing three birds. Jars of blistered rats. A page marked to a poisoning by gift.

subject: bookwyrm's chambers
fact: The bookwyrm's chambers took half the top floor — comfortable, neatly arranged, no extravagance to it.
source_quote: Bookwyrm last, and by then the tower was fighting me. Her chambers took half the top floor — comfortable, neatly arranged, no extravagance to it.
